preconditions.description: The input size does not exceed 1048576 bytes.

preconditions.expression: any(c in stdin for c in ' ' if c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input contains at least one space character.

preconditions.expression: any(c in stdin for c in '#')
preconditions.description: The input contains at least one '#' character.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join(line.strip() if line.strip().startswith('#') else line.replace(' ', '') for line in stdin.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The output is the input with spaces removed from non-amplifying lines and lines concatenated appropriately.

postconditions.expression: all(line.startswith('#') or ' ' not in line for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: All non-amplifying lines in the output do not contain spaces.

postconditions.expression: all(line.startswith('#') or line == line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: All non-amplifying lines in the output are stripped of leading and trailing spaces.
